head: Use the skill-creator skill (use the anthropic-skills:skill-creator skill).
Validate the skill: frontmatter has name and description, referenced files exist, cross-skill links resolve.
Test cases if structural. Skip if subjective.
Run Opening a PR.
State the exit condition as a checkable predicate before the first iteration (tests green, repro fixed, all N PRs merged, pixel-diff zero).
Pick the wake mechanism using Claude Code's /loop skill (a built-in, not a pstack skill).
Each iteration makes the smallest change the evidence justifies, verifies it against the predicate, commits if it advanced, discards changes that didn't help.
Mid-run discoveries are yours. Address broken skills, related bugs, flaky verifiers, review noise, tooling failures, orphaned follow-ups, and fixable drift yourself via poteto-mode.
Checkpoint every iteration via the show-me-your-work skill, a row for what changed and whether the predicate moved.
Stop when the predicate is met.
The operator's gates come first.
Spawn one owner per PR, and keep its work where a replacement can find it.
Run owners in parallel off trunk, never stacked, so each PR lands on its own.
Swarm-verify once. A full swarm runs once, at the code-ready head.
The owner merges only what you verified, tested on the trunk it lands on.

Run the root layer. Anything that loosens a gate, such as a raised budget or an allowlist entry, needs a verifier's proof and then your fresh countersign, because the owner is the one who wants green.
Stand down at once on the operator's stop.
Run Autopilot-full's owners, minus the landing.
Give the topology one writer.
Absorb drift at the root.
Deliver the chain, then keep your hands off it.
Declare the mode and resolve the forge before any poll.
Work the merge frontier and nothing above it.
One babysitter per stack. Before starting, check nothing else is already on it.
Never mutate stack topology. No base retarget, rebase, stack-wide submit, or force-push from inside a babysit.
Order is conflicts, then review threads, then CI.
Trust the active forge's verdict, not a green check list.
Classify CI before any retrigger.
Bugbot is triaged skeptically, always.
Stop at the human's line.
Reproduce it yourself on the matching surface via the control skill (Non-negotiables), even when a debug or instrumentation protocol says to ask the user to reproduce.
Binary-search the cause. Form the candidate hypotheses, then rule them out until one survives.
Plan the fix. If it crosses a function boundary, architect first.
Verify on the same surface.
Stage the commits so the failing repro lands before the fix in git history.
Run Opening a PR.
If the repo has no docs/agents/issue-tracker.md, run the setup-matt-pocock-skills skill first, so the spec and tickets land in the tracker.
Work bigger than one session goes to the wayfinder skill instead.
Run the grill-with-docs skill. It grills over the design tree, one round at a time, and records resolved terms and hard-to-reverse decisions with the domain-modeling skill in GLOSSARY.md and ADRs.
Run the to-spec skill. Agree the seams under test in its step 2, and keep them in the spec's Testing Decisions.
Run the to-tickets skill. Each ticket carries its seams under test and its acceptance criteria, and the user approves the breakdown.
Stop. Build only when the user asks.
Frame. State what variant is under test and what behavior counts as success.
Set up sanitized environments. Per-candidate working dir with the variant in place.
Author one organic prompt. What a user would type.
Spawn N parallel candidates on different models per the arena skill's Phase B.
Spawn one blinded judge on a different model family per the arena skill's Phase C.
Verify the chain from transcripts, not self-report.
Read every candidate output yourself end to end.
how over the affected subsystem.
architect for parallel design exploration.
Write the throughput checkpoint as four todo items.

Delegate code-writing to a subagent using your configured feature model (default sonnet) with a specific scope (file paths, named data shape and its organizing structure per principle-model-the-domain, a state machine over scattered booleans, a table/registry over branching, a typed model over repeated shape assumptions, chosen before the delegate writes logic, and success criteria).
Verify on the matching surface.
Rebase into small, ordered commits.
Run Opening a PR.
Ground the workload and architecture before choosing the metric.
Build the measurement harness, prove its sensitivity, then freeze it (the build-the-lever principle skill).
Open the decision log via the show-me-your-work skill.
Ground each hypothesis in the architecture model from step 1, so it names a specific mechanism ("defer X off the boot path because it blocks first paint"), not "try memoizing something".
Loop, one hypothesis per iteration:
Push past the first plateau.
Stop when the predicate is met, or when the remaining ideas are marginal and not worth their cost.
Run Opening a PR with the accepted commits stacked in the order they landed.
Route through the how skill.
Throughput checkpoint stays one line: throughput checkpoint: n/a, read-only investigation.
Produce the how-shaped output (Overview / Key Concepts / How It Works / Where Things Live / Gotchas), or a recommendation with a tradeoffs table if the request is a decision between alternatives.
Apply the unslop skill to the reply.
When the change is one or two files with an obvious approach, skip the plan.
Settle open questions by prototype before you write.
Explore in subagents with subagent_type: "pstack-cc:poteto-agent" and an explicit model per the Subagents section (the guard-the-context-window principle skill).
Copy the skeleton below into the plan file and fill every placeholder.
Write under /technical-writing in full, then /unslop.
Run node scripts/check-plan.mjs <plan.md> and fix every line it prints (the encode-lessons-in-structure principle skill).
Hand back. Post the plan path and the script's output, then stop.
Frame. State the done predicate as something countable ("all 126 units merged, each ledger-verified unit-test-verified or better").
Install the runtime. Run orch init.
Pilot. Push one unit through the whole path: brief, worker, verification, stack entry, ledger row, merge.
Scale. Spawn a rolling window of workers up to the in-flight cap, refilling as children finish.
Drain. Run the queue discipline below at every drain point.
Land. Landing is continuous, never a terminal phase.

Close. Drain the final inbox, reconcile every spawned agent to a terminal row (done, abandoned, zombie-reconciled), confirm the predicate on the real artifact, confirm every landed PR has a verdict for its current head SHA, audit the trail per show-me-your-work including its cross-model review, encode recurring corrections into preferences.md or the brief template.
Stop at a safe boundary.
Take no irreversible action to pause.
Make the work durable. Commit uncommitted edits as one clear wip: commit on the current branch so nothing is lost.
Write the resume note off-context.
Capture a baseline trace via the matching control skill.
how to ground hypotheses. Don't claim a perf ceiling without running it first.
Plan the fix from the trace.
Parse and compare the artifacts (JSON to sqlite, diff).
Cite the measurement in the PR.
Run Opening a PR.
Scope the decision the prototype exists to make: which layout, which interaction, which density, or for an empirical fork which behavior, timing, or approach.
Gather references when the design space is open.
Build throwaway in an isolated scratch dir, separate from production source.
When comparing alternatives, build them behind one switcher (buttons or a keypress), each variant labeled.
Verify on the matching surface.
Present alternatives, tradeoffs, and a recommendation.
Pin the behavior contract first.
Name the structure the code is missing per principle-model-the-domain.
Name the target shape. State what the module layout, types, and call graph should be if built today (principle-foundational-thinking, principle-redesign-from-first-principles).
Subtract before you add. Delete dead code, collapse one-caller wrappers, drop redundant validators, and remove orphan references before introducing the new shape (principle-subtract-before-you-add).
Move in small behavior-preserving steps, each keeping the pin green.
Prove behavior is unchanged on the real artifact, not "it compiles" (principle-prove-it-works).
Confirm the change is worth keeping.
Rebase into small ordered commits.
Capture the live signal on the matching surface via the control skill: a CPU profile for a spinning process, a heap snapshot for a leak, a CDP trace for a visual glitch.
Reduce the artifact to the smoking gun: the function on the hot path, the retainer chain from the leaked object to a GC root, the loop firing without input.
Prove the mechanism before believing it.
Map the finding back to source: file, symbol, the line that allocates or schedules.
Throughput checkpoint stays one line: throughput checkpoint: n/a, read-only forensics.

Locate the prior trail. A local transcript under the active workspace's transcript directory, ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/ (<slug> is the workspace path with every character that is not a letter or digit turned into "-".
Reconstruct operational state. The branch and worktree, what already landed (git log, git diff against the base), the open todos, the decisions made.
Diff done vs pending. Compare what shipped against what was planned, name the resume point, do not re-run the prior repro or redo completed work.
Route the remaining work to the matching playbook and pick the verdict: continue the execution, ship a finished recommendation, ratify or override a prior conclusion, or postmortem a failed run.
Verify the inherited claims against the original goal on the real artifact (the principle-prove-it-works skill).
Resolve the forge, then verify each PR independently before it lands.
Land only the contiguous verified run rooted at the bottom.
Re-check that the verdicts still describe the code.
Land bottom-up, one PR at a time.
Leave the stack alone while it lands.
Stop at the ceiling. Extending the run takes new verdicts, so it is a new pass through step 1.
Identify the format and load it with the right tool.
Transform the raw artifact into a form you can query.
Narrow to the cause. Query for the frames that hold the most time and walk the call tree to the hot path.
Attribute to source. Map the hot frame to file, symbol, and line via the artifact's own symbols.
If you have a paired capture, diff the before and after artifacts to confirm.
Hand back a cited diagnosis, no fix unless asked.
Establish the baseline first, before any migration: a visual regression harness that screenshots the current component across its states, plus the target when matching two implementations.
Anti-shortcut clauses, stated and held: no harness modifications, no baseline tampering, no component restructuring to make a diff pass.
Migrate one component at a time.
Verify each component against its baseline via image diff on the matching surface via the control skill.
Run Opening a PR per component or per safe batch.
Snapshot and audit. Record df -h /, then run scripts/worktree-audit.sh [-b <pr-base-ref>] [repo-path] (principle-build-the-lever).
The bucket is advice, not permission.

Verify usage before deleting. For every verify-recent-chat row, or anything you doubt, fan subagents out to read the transcripts and report whether the chat is pinned or ongoing and which worktrees it touches (principle-guard-the-context-window, transcripts are bulk).
Pause on irreversible loss. wip:N is N tracked uncommitted edits.
Prune the confirmed set. Per path, git worktree remove --force <path>.
Simulators and other reclaimers. Simulators are usually the next-biggest win.
